senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עור; cmp. חָוַר, חֲוַרְוָור) [white, blank,] blind.
units: Bekh. 44ᵃ (ref. to Lev. XXI, 18) ע׳ בין סומא וכ׳ ‘ivver means both blind of one eye as well as of both; a. e.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:11">B. Mets. V, 11</cite>, a. fr. <he>משום ולפני ע׳ וכ׳</he> it comes under the category of the law (<cite ref="Leviticus 19:14">Lev. XIX, 14</cite>), ‘place no stumbling block before the blind’ (cause no man to sin).—Pl. <he>עִוְּרִים</he>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 146:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXLVI, 8</cite> <he>ומי הן הע׳ הדורות … כע׳</he> who are the blind? These latter generations that walk in the Law like blind men; a. e.—[Usually <cite ref="O00336"><he>סוּמָא</he></cite>].—Denom.
